hook: Karpathy turned US data into a Civ map

beats.say: Andrej Karpathy asked Claude to fill a Civilization style game map with real United States data, and let Opus 5.5 download and parse it.
Seven hours and 45 thousand lines of code later it worked, pulling 31 data sources including the Census, NOAA and USGS onto a 25 kilometer hex grid.
Built with Claude Code, the result has 19 interactive lenses, city views for 524 metros, and an explorer for county level data.
